quest.title: Vagrants and Scamps
quest.description: The Steambird seems to have had a crime unfold on their own doorstep...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.title: Questioning Melusine and Answering Machine: Act I

dialogues.speaker: Messy Footprints
dialogues.text: (A tangle of footprints, with no consistent depth or pattern.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh, look at all these footprints. Looks like quite a few people came by...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Based on these patterns, they belong to four different people.

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: The paper has already put a lid on this news and isolated all non-related individuals. As such, we can assume that these footprints were left behind during the crime itself.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Let's record this in our investigation notes first!

talks.objective: Make some inquiries about what happened

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: What kind of attitude is that, Editor Jenck!?

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: And what about your attitude, Agent Talochard?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I'm helping you with a problem here!

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: And did I ask for your help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you two arguing about?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: What good timing. Help me explain. I'm Agent Talochard from the Marechaussee Phantom, investigating a case at The Steambird.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: But this amateur keeps interfering with my deductive process. I mean, just who is the investigator here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it is kinda odd for an amateur to advise a professional...

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: I was merely suggesting that she not jump to any conclusions. She's barely started investigating and she's already decided I'm the killer! It's defamation, I tell you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It does sound like defamation... but it's important to find the... W—Wait! Killer? What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Um... It's possible that an unfortunate newspaper employee has been... Y'know. Oh, it's so sad.

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: What do you mean by "y'know"? He's missing, that's all!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Even if he is just missing, you're still mixed up in this, and that's because you drove him away! Didn't you, Editor Jenck?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Let's paint the scene! An idealistic young reporter finally gets a job with the newspaper of his dreams. He yearns to fight the evils of society with the power of his pen.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: But, to his dismay, he discovers the newspaper is as corrupt as everything else. Black of ink, black of heart!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Valuable stories are ignored in favor of puff pieces about popular music. His ideals are met with lies, his dignity trampled upon... Oh, it's such a sad story!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Until finally, one night, he awakes from a nightmare upon a tear-sodden pillow, and decides to flee the place that shattered his dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: What are you, an investigator or a bad novelist? You're cawing like a crow!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: So, Editor Jenck, is this the truth behind his disappearance? You are his boss, are you not? Yet you deny all responsibility?

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: Agent Talochard, your imagination knows no bounds. May I suggest you hand in your badge and take up a job at our newspaper? We also publish fantastical stories, you see...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Fantastical? As if. My deductions are entirely plausible.

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Agent Talochard, let me clarify. The missing employee is Sir Arthur. Ring any bells?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sir Arthur? Paimon's heard that name somewhere.

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Sir Arthur is the steambird that gives The Steambird its name. Our symbol, our mascot.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! That Sir Arthur. The one who stands by the door, announcing the news.

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Yes. So, a steambird that can neither walk nor fly. I fail to see how I could have driven it away.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Wait, blast you! Shouldn't you have mentioned that before? Do you have something against me?

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Look, you're the one who turned up and started accusing me of murder. If anyone has an axe to grind, it's you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, do stop bickering. The important thing right now is to find Sir Arthur.

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Yes, Paimon's right.

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Ah, Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie, Agent Curve, you've returned.

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Thank you for your help, Jenck. You may go now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie, hello! And who is this...

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. And this is...

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: Hello, all. I am merely Curve, Agent Talochard's assistant.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—You can talk!? Like Sir Arthur!?

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: No. Agent Curve is a special investigations drone belonging to the Marechaussee Phantom. He's remotely operated by someone back in the office. Isn't that the case, Agent Talochard?

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Huh? Oh, yes. Yes, that's the case...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I didn't know Fontaine had such advanced technology.

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Heh. Well, unfortunately this isn't the time to bring you up to date on our advances, much as I would enjoy doing so. Right now, I need you both to help with getting Sir Arthur back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Us? You've already got two professional investigators...

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Yeah! This is our case!

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Ahem. The thing is, Agent Talochard, neither of you are official investigators with the Marechaussee Phantom, are you?

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: You... You watch what you say! This is a genuine uniform, I'll have you know!

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: But as I understand it, you were simply passing by and decided to start investigating of your own accord. I can't imagine why. I wonder if I should speak to the Marechaussee Phantom and—

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: No, no! There's no need. Okay, I admit it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!? You're impersonating Marechaussee Phantom agents?

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Well, to be honest, they're just agents who are a bit special. In any case, I'm grateful to Agent Curve, who told me some very interesting things while we were interviewing the local residents.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Curve! What did you tell her?

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: As you know, Agent Talochard, the Mosso Protocols require me to answer all of Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie's questions honestly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Mosso Protocols? Is that some kind of customer service agreement?

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Ugh, those pesky protocols!

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: #I don't mean to offend, agents. But Sir Arthur is of great importance to The Steambird, and I would like to have more professionals on the case. {NICKNAME} and Paimon, for example.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You want us to join the investigation?

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Indeed I do. And on behalf of The Steambird, I promise you will be rewarded. What do you think?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We're in.

response.speaker: Euphrasie
response.text: Excellent. I hope you will all work together. The newspaper will be most grateful.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Okay. Just don't tell the Maison that we're here on the sly...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wait, you're playing hooky?

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Hey, let a girl have her secrets, why don't you? Maybe when I know you better...

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Okay, Curve, if we're teaming up, we should show them our notes.

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: Please take these statements, which we took from nearby residents.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! Have you got any leads, then?

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Of course. We're good at our jobs.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Okay, so next we should investigate the scene. Sir Arthur disappeared last night, so there should still be clues to be found!

talks.objective: Look for clues at the scene

dialogues.speaker: Notch on the Pedestal
dialogues.text: (An empty pedestal. If you look closely, you can see a notch left by a sharp implement.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Based on the shape and depth, the mark here was made by a small, knife-like sharp object.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So where's the knife now...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Let's record this in our investigation notes first!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Without real evidence, all you can do is insult me.

dialogues.speaker: Lombroso
dialogues.text: (The puppy looks at you, as if waiting for something.)

dialogues.speaker: Pile of Dirty, Empty Wine Bottles
dialogues.text: (A pile of dirty, empty wine bottles from which a strange smell wafts, like a sea filled with salty fish.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those bottles! We found one of those by The Steambird!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Have you searched the entire scene? Are you sure you haven't missed anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've got so much evidence! Footprints, a bottle... Paimon's brain is almost fried!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's think, {NICKNAME}. Does this give us any leads? Maybe something that tells us what to do next?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Things are a bit clearer now, but Paimon's not sure anything we've found is very useful. Paimon guesses the best lead is that vagrant, Rocher.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I agree! One set of footprints must be his, right? And he sounds like the most suspicious.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why so?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Well, he's a vagrant and vagrants are meant to wander about. But he stays in one place. He's definitely up to something!

choices.text: I guess that makes a little sense.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Trust me, I'm right! Let's go and check out the docks. Someone said they saw him there.

choices.text: I'm not sure that's entirely logical.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Aren't these a girl's clothes...?

talks.objective: Speak with the unknown red-haired person

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Men! Rocher has to be hiding here somewhere. He owes, so he has to pay! Find him for me!

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: And as if not paying his debts wasn't enough, he's made me chase after him! I'm going to trash his place and break his legs!

dialogues.speaker: Freed Puppy
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: What are you barking at?

dialogues.speaker: Freed Puppy
dialogues.text: *whimpers*

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Stop! What are you doing!?

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Who are you? Mind your own business.

dialogues.speaker: Accomplice of "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Director 42... Look at the uniform. They're the Marechaussee Phantom. Maybe we should fall back?

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: I don't care about who they are. Steel yourself, men! With me!

talks.objective: Beat back the unknown red-haired person

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Information retrieved: The woman in the photo is...

talks.objective: Beat back the unknown red-haired person

dialogues.speaker: Accomplice of "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: #Director 42, the {M#blond}{F#blonde} one and the robot are difficult to handle...

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Blasted... mud! I slipped and fell. Guess Rocher got lucky. Okay, lads, move!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: #I see you're a fighter, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, that's nothing for {M#him}{F#her}.

dialogues.speaker: Freed Puppy
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, no need to thank me, pup. We're looking for your master. Does he owe people money?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Hey! Listen, pup, your master took Sir Arthur to pay off a debt, right? Spit it out! Where's he hiding?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: In my humble analysis, this line of questioning will fail due to language incompatibilities.

dialogues.speaker: Freed Puppy
dialogues.text: (The puppy looks at you, as if to say "Yeah, obviously.")

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Th—Then let's search the area. That thief must be here somewhere.

talks.objective: Search for traces of the vagrant Rocher

dialogues.speaker: Freed Puppy
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is there something in that chest?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Knock on the chest.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Knock again.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Knock again.)

dialogues.speaker: Strange Box
dialogues.text: Stop that! There's nothing in here!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Ha! In that case, you won't mind if we smash this chest up, would you?

talks.objective: Talk to the person hiding in the chest

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah! There's someone hiding in the chest!
D—Don't hit me!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: So you're Rocher?
I don't have any Mora. Not a single coin!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: It's okay. We chased the debt collectors off.

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Oh! Wonderful. And what a charming young Melusine you are... You are right, I am Rocher. And when I make it big, I won't forget to reward you generously.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Dream on, you thief! We're with the Marechaussee Phantom and we're here to arrest you.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: You stole Sir Arthur last night, didn't you? Confess! Who did you sell it to?

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Me? Stole Sir Arthur? By the Hydro Archon! As if a person of my standing would do such a thing. And I've been hiding in this chest since yesterday evening!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Oh, really? Curve, what's the verdict?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Biodata anomaly identified. Mr. Rocher, you are lying.

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Me? Lying? Nonsense! Calumny! Slander! Where's the evidence?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The bottle by The Steambird...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We found a bottle by The Steambird, just like these ones. You left it there, right?

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Even if the bottle is the same, that doesn't mean I left it there. Why, a place the size of Fontaine must be full of drunkards like me...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Result replicated. Biodata anomaly identified. Mr. Rocher, you are lying.

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Hey! What's with this metal bucket? If I'm going to have my honesty and nobility smeared, I want an actual person to do it!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Less shouting. Listen here, thief. We're going to turn this place upside down and shake it to see if any evidence falls out. So no crying when we find something.

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Look, then. Look! Without real evidence, all you can do is insult me.

talks.objective: Find a way to break Rocher's argument

dialogues.speaker: Freed Puppy
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's he doing?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I know! He must have recognized a scent. The bottle must have Rocher's scent on it.

dialogues.speaker: Freed Puppy
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Lombroso, did you have to...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Rocher! See, the dog recognizes your scent. Do you still deny that you were at the newspaper office?

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Okay, calm down, won't you? And Lombroso, you traitor...

dialogues.speaker: Lombroso
dialogues.text: (Lombroso wags his tail happily, as if saying, "I don't understand!")

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Agh, okay, I admit it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Curve, you were spot on. How did you know? Can you detect liars?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Correct, Ms. Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Really? You're a lie detector?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Hey! Didn't we talk about prying into other people's private lives? Get to know us first!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Hurry up and come clean, Rocher. What did you do?

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: B—But that's my private life, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: How dare you! 'Fess up, or you'll be enjoying plenty of privacy in the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: No! Okay, I admit I've told a few tiny little lies. But I didn't steal Sir Arthur, honest!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: I slept by The Steambird's entrance last night, that's all. When I went to sleep Sir Arthur was there, but when I woke up it was gone. And I was worried people would suspect me, so I ran...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: That's not the full story, is it? We've been told you've been seen there a lot lately. Planning your heist, no doubt!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: That's not true! I was hoping to get some work there. You know, start off picking up litter, and maybe some bigwig might spot your potential and then, whoosh, your career takes off...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like you were the one causing the litter with your stinky wine bottles. That's not going to impress any bigwigs, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I don't believe it. He's lying again!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: It's true! Let me finish... I know how I look now. But I used to work at the Palais Mermonia...

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Well, it was my wife that got me the job. Her family used to be a big deal and they still have some connections. Anyway, I used to be respectable.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Really? I'm not sure which is worse, begging for food or relying on your wife.

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: D—Don't say that. I wanted to become successful under my own steam, obviously. But that's when the problems started.

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: A while back, some people offered to let me in on their business. Don't worry about start-up funds, they said, you can owe us. So I signed up!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: But I soon realized that the goods they were giving me were unsellable garbage... And then they started demanding I pay what I owed them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Were those the people who were here?

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Yeah. I didn't have any choice but to pawn things from home to get some money. But I didn't realize that what I'd taken belonged to my wife. Something her grandfather left her...

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: When she realized this, I was too scared to tell her the truth, so I said that I'd lost money gambling. She was furious, and threw me out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why not tell the truth? Maybe she'd have forgiven you if she'd known...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Hmph. What does this guy know about telling the truth? If he claimed he lost it gambling, he could blame bad luck. If he lost it on a bad business deal, he'd have to admit to being a good-for-nothing loser.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But what does this have to do with the newspaper?

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: A month ago, The Steambird reported on a team of scammers, the Elegant Tableware Confrerie. Those were the people who conned me! Professional con artists!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow. The Steambird is pretty good at their job, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: I know! That's why I wanted to work there. It would have been a respectable job, and I could have earned enough to get my wife's things back.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Hmph. Curve, is that true?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Biodata has returned to normal range. Mr. Rocher is not lying.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Huh? So it really wasn't him... So, did you see anything suspicious last night?

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: I did! I was woken up by some noise and I think I saw someone. Someone very small, running away... That's suspicious, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Someone small? The statements from the residents mentioned a young boy. Could be him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But where would we find him? If only we had a puppy to show us the way again.

dialogues.speaker: Lombroso
dialogues.text: (Lombroso wags his tail happily. He seems to know he's being talked about.)

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it... Lombroso has an excellent sense of smell. Why don't we see if he can pick up a scent?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's not sure it'll work, but it's worth a try!

talks.objective: Let the puppy sniff the clues

dialogues.speaker: Lombroso
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Where's he going? Quick, follow that puppy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The puppy has stopped. Could the owner of the button live nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Look, there's someone at home in that house over there. Let's go ask.

dialogues.speaker: Baulande! Lombroso!
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

talks.objective: Talk to the person in front of the house

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: I don't know anything! Also, I hate you all!

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Don't run, Kevin. Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry to interrupt...

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: You... What do you guys want?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Don't worry, madam. We're agents from the Marechaussee Phantom, and we're investigating a theft. A button linked to your family was found at the scene. Do you have any comments?

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Oh, I sewed that on for Kevin just recently. But Kevin's a good child, he couldn't possibly be mixed up in theft.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I knew it! Madam, I regret to say you have raised a thief!

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Please be reasonable, Agent. Even if this is Kevin's button, all that proves is that he was at the newspaper office.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: And why would he be there, if not to steal?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you just say "newspaper office"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! How did you know that that's where the theft happened?

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: I... No... You must have misheard me.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Ironclad irrefutable evidence! Don't try and lie your way out of this, you'll only make things worse for you and for your son!

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: No! My son didn't mean to steal anything. He only took that knife to defend himself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Knife? I thought we were looking for a mechanical steambird?

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: You mean Sir Arthur? But Kevin only had a knife when he came home.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Madam Madeleine! Why did your son go to the newspaper? What did he do there? Tell us everything!

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Oh... My Kevin just adores that steambird outside the newspaper office. Every time we go into town, he goes to visit it and tells it all his troubles.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Yesterday evening we had a bit of a fight and Kevin stormed off... to the newspaper office.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: But this time, he came back with a knife. He said he'd found it stuck in the steambird's pedestal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that explains the notch. But why did he take the knife?

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: He said he noticed that Sir Arthur was missing and wanted to find it. But then some drunken man staggered towards him. He got scared and picked up the knife.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could we see the knife?

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: I told him to get rid of it. I was worried it might cause trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: That knife could be a clue. We'll need to ask Kevin where it is.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: I wish you could, but he's run off again. We're arguing a lot at the moment, about his father. You see, his father's a mechanical engineer posted outside the city. Kevin hasn't seen him for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: He's having a bit of an early rebellious phase. He's furious with his father for not being here.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: A problem child, huh? Not easy to deal with. Still, we'll need to find him and ask about that knife.

talks.objective: Go to Kevin to inquire about the blade

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: That dog...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Information retrieved: The canine sense of smell...

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Who are you? Why are you making such an unholy racket?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You... You might want to try saying thanks! We just saved you.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Thanks? Haha! What's up? Why the angry face? You gonna hit me?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Kid, a thumping would do you good. But we're professionals, Marechaussee Phantom agents. We don't beat people in public.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: But we do need to ask you some questions. If you keep anything from us, we'll have to take you in! And then... Well, we won't be in public, will we?

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Take me in? Sure, go ahead. And take him in too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err... him? Who is that?

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Baulande! That's his name. You should arrest him too!

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: I wish he wasn't! I haven't even seen him for a year.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah. No wonder Madam Madeleine said this guy used to complain to Sir Arthur. Paimon guesses that's the root of the problem?

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Complain? That's a laugh! I was working out how to set up his speech patterns. You haven't realized, I guess, that everything it says is programmed in advance.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: As soon as I figure out how to do that, I'm going to program him to say "Baulande is a big fat weasel" all day, every day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's why you were hanging out next to Sir Arthur? Wow, you really are a problem child...

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: But Sir Arthur disappeared last night, so I won't be able to finish my research. I don't know who took him.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: You don't think I took Sir Arthur, do you? Sure, I'm a problem child. But stealing a mechanical steambird isn't one of those problems.

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: In my humble analysis, Mr. Kevin, you have come into contact with a knife?

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Wait... This robot can speak? How does it do that? Is it the same as Sir Arthur?

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Shows how much you know. Curve is much more sophisticated than Sir Arthur. For a start, he doesn't need to be told what to say.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Then... Wow, you're awesome, Curve. Hey, could you say something for me? Say "Baulande is a big fat weasel." I know you can do it!

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: First, you must prove that said statement is true.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Prove it? What the... So that means you can't do it? You suck. Even Sir Arthur could say that.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Do not confuse Curve with others. He's no liar!

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Hmph. Well, I was going to tell you about the knife if he said it. But he didn't, so the deal's off!

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Listen, brat, I don't think you understand.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: If we find Sir Arthur, you can carry on with your plan to slander your father, right? We're on the same side here!

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Oh! That... That makes sense. So...

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Okay, I'll tell you. I threw the knife into the sea. I'll mark the spot on your map. Now hurry up and find Sir Arthur!

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: That's more like it, kid. Is there anything else you should tell us? The more we know, the faster we can find Sir Arthur.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Let me think... I went to The Steambird but Sir Arthur wasn't there. Instead, there was that knife. Then a drunk man came at me, so I panicked and grabbed the knife to frighten him off. That's it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's what happened. Curve, did you spot any problems?

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: In my humble analysis, Mr. Kevin is not lying. But I did notice anomalies with Madam Madeleine's pupil dilation and breathing earlier.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Was she lying?

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: I am unable to confirm that. There was, however, a data fluctuation when she told us that "his father's a mechanical engineer posted outside the city."

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Haha. I can explain that. She was lying. Pop doesn't know a spring from a spanner. As if he could be an engineer...

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: My mother's a very experienced liar. She practices on me every day, you see, so you wouldn't be able to tell.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: A little while ago she brought a puppy home and said it was a present from my father. But I snuck a look at her letters, and it was from some other man!

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Well, maybe that man is your new father, right? So congrats, kid! I hope your new father does a better job than the old drunken leech.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Hmm... I might not like what you say, but at least you're being straight with me. I wish my mom would do that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kevin, don't dwell on that. Your mother's just trying to protect you. She's worried you won't be able to cope if you have to deal with too much all at once.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: I don't want to know! It's knowing things that causes all my problems.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: No, no, it's the exact opposite! Your problems come from not knowing enough.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Not knowing enough?

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: For example, you still don't know that humans lie constantly. Your mother, your father, even you.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: That's the answer to your problem, kid. And when you realize that, you'll stop having such high expectations. Then, you'll be a kid with answers, not problems.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: A—Answers?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm feeling kind of attacked...

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Oh? Do you disagree? Unless... you've never ever told even a single lie?

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Forget it, I don't need to know the answer. I rather like you right now, so let's not spoil this beautiful moment.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: The important thing is to find the knife. We've got to go, kid. Think about what I said and you'll find the answers you need.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't listen to her, Kevin. Listen to Paimon. Go home and have a good talk with your mom. If she lied to you it's because she had a good reason.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: I know. Maybe I should go home.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Yeah, he's a criminal. And my so-called father, sure, but he hasn't even been home in a year. Arrest him for bad parenting!

talks.objective: Go to where Kevin threw away the blade
Go to where Kevin threw away the blade

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is where Kevin got rid of the knife? Paimon thinks it's time to get wet!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I could. But Curve can't go underwater, unfortunately, and I need to stay here with him.

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Sorry. Guess it's all up to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't understand why a robot can't go diving. Are you sure you're not just shirking work?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Never mind. Let's go, {NICKNAME}. We need clues!

talks.objective: Go underwater to search for the blade

dialogues.speaker: Freed Puppy
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Talochard, Curve, we've got the knife! Here, take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Huh, this could match up with the notch on the pedestal. But... it's just an ordinary table knife. Why would any criminal carry one like that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err... Maybe they ate at a restaurant and stole a knife there? Then dropped it at the scene of the crime?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I give your deductive skills 1 point. Out of 1,000.

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Relevant information retrieved: A month ago, The Steambird exposed a case of fraud involving the Elegant Tableware Confrerie.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: The Elegant Tableware Confrerie? Oh, I remember that. A knife like this was part of the evidence gathered... Hah! They must be responsible!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There you go again, with the "must be responsible."

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Really? We can head back to the office and confirm it. We've got enough time left today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? I thought you two weren't really investigators. Can you really check up on other cases?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Okay, I guess we're kind of friends now, so I'll tell you...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I'm an evidence clerk with the Marechaussee Phantom. As such, getting a piece of evidence from the stores is easy-peasy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A what? Is that even a job?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So Curve is...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Evidence. Indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! The evidence is running around solving cases?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: And why not? You aren't even evidence, but you're doing the same.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But didn't Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie say something about Curve being remotely operated...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: She was helping maintain Curve's cover. She seemed to know his story... which is that he's a lie-detecting robot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's hard to believe. How come Paimon's never heard of something that incredible?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Because he's been stuck in the evidence storeroom. Curve is a vital piece of evidence in a case dating back 30 years.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So are you secretly investigating that shocking crime to identify the true perpetrator?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: As if my life's that exciting. I just got bored, and decided to take Curve out for a walk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And that's it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Curve, what do you think?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Biodata anomaly identified. Agent Talochard, you are lying.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}. I was just saying I was starting to like you... and now you're using the Mosso Protocols' loopholes against me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The what protocols now? You mentioned those earlier or something, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: My great creator, Dr. Mosso, added some rules to my core programming to ensure the accuracy of my lie detection.

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Those rules require me to answer all questions with complete accuracy and honesty.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you can detect a lie, but not tell one? And if someone asks you a question, you're obliged to answer it?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Correct, Ms. Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What clever rules! So, is this Mosso guy some top scientist at the Fontaine Research Institute?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: He was a top scientist, until he passed away. He died 30 years ago and Curve became evidence.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He died? How!?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Relevant information retrieved: Dr. Mosso died in a duel attempting to prove his innocence, after a court found him guilty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why was he found guilty?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Relevant information retrieved: 30 years ago...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Stop, stop! You keep asking questions! And if you keep asking questions, Curve has to keep answering them.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Our priority should be finding Sir Arthur. Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie will be too upset to eat if we don't find him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon... finds that unlikely.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Well... Well anyway, Curve and I are going to see what we can find out about that knife. Let's meet first thing tomorrow at the Palais Mermonia.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon's so curious! Couldn't you indulge her this once?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: We'll indulge you tomorrow. How about we make you a delicious breakfast?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, breakfast? Okay, looking forward to it already, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: See you tomorrow morning, then!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, they've gone. Paimon can't help but feel there's something going on on their end, though...

choices.text: Best not to stick your nose into other people's private lives.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. It's been a busy day, we should go get some rest. We'll meet them at the Palais Mermonia tomorrow.

choices.text: You can be nosy about that tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Mom, are you telling the truth? That Pop and... and you...

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Shh. Kevin, you can't talk about that outside of the house. You know now, and that's enough.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: I know... And I'll be good from now on.

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: I swear, on that metal bucket, that I am not lying to anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Lombroso
dialogues.text: (Lombroso looks at you, as if to say "I don't understand.")

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's not that one? Let's try another.

dialogues.speaker: Ragged Clothes
dialogues.text: (Ragged old clothes from who knows where, emitting an odd smell...)

dialogues.speaker: Old Photo
dialogues.text: (A picture of a loving couple.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this... Rocher and his wife?

dialogues.speaker: Freed Puppy
dialogues.text: (The puppy looks at you, as if waiting for something.)

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: This won't be of any use. Try something else.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: There's no way Kevin would ever steal anything.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Can a problem child really find the answers he needs?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is where Kevin got rid of the knife? Paimon thinks it's time to get wet!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I could. But Curve can't go underwater, unfortunately, and I need to stay here with him.

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Sorry. Guess it's all up to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know what? We've already met a robot dog and he could swim! Paimon guesses Curve isn't that advanced.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: How dare you suggest Curve is less advanced than a dog! He's just not feeling very well. What was the dog's name, anyway? When Curve is better, we'll have a competition and see who wins!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, someone's being unnecessarily competitive...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: In my humble opinion, we should be looking for evidence.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Never mind. Let's go diving, {NICKNAME}. We need clues!

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Kevin is back home... But this can't go on. Isn't it time to tell him?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Curve, how are you feeling today?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Motherboard temperature: Below warning line. Core functionality: 20%.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Hmm... Not much lower than yesterday. Keep it up, Curve!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's that puppy doing?

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: A con artist! Just like Momma! And that other one!

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: It's not like that, Kevin...

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Come on, you blasted beasts! Eat me if you can!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! Kevin's been caught by monsters!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Isn't that fine, though? That's a problem child we're talking about — and any monster that eats him will inherit those problems. It'll save us some trouble, won't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! We only need to take care of the problem, alright? Who wants to take care of a kid!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since we have the notes, we might as well see what they say!
